entities.text:
High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. By virtue of an award No.DCJ/LA/Award/Chak Kalasa- Addl./2024-25/439 dated 14.12.2024, the Deputy Commissioner, as a Competent Authority for land acquisition Jammu, under the National Highways Act, 1956, came to acquire land comprised in khasra No.157 min situated in village Chak Kalasa, tehsil Marh, district Jammu to the extent of 8 marlas in khasra No.157 min.
2.
By reference to said khasra No.157 min, there are two owners, namely, Bihari S/o Jethu who is having land measuring 1.17 kanal and other being Ami Chand S/o Shana who was having 18 marla of land.
3. It is out of 18 marlas of Ami Chand's land that 8 marlas are said to have been acquired with assessed compensation of Rs.13,71,310/-.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Ami Chand is said to have expired and left his legal heirs namely, Gari Ram (son), Nanak Chand (son) along with his daughters namely, Anita Devi, Veena Devi & Melo Devi who constituted the petitioner-Raghubir Singh as their lawful attorney in their name and on their behalf, empowering him to deal with the land comprised in khasra No.157 and also further empowering him to receive compensation but still the Deputy Commissioner, Jammu, as a Competent Authority, is said to be not acknowledging the status of the petitioner to earn the payment of the compensation amount of Rs.14,05,593/- thereby constraining the petitioner to approach this Court.
5. Issue notice only to respondent No.2-Deputy Commissioner, Jammu.
6.
Ms. Nazia Fazal, Advocate vice Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of the respondent No.2.
7. Status of deposit of compensation amount to be apprised to this Court on next date of hearing.

8. In the meantime, Mr. Rakesh Chargotra, Sr. Advocate appearing for the petitioner is directed to confirm as to whether mutation of inheritance was attested with respect to actual land owner-Ami Chand in favour of his legal heirs from whom the petitioner is said to have drawn the power of attorney for enabling him to represent them in the matter of even receiving the compensation for 8 marlas of acquired land.

(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 24.12.2025 Sneha Raghbir Singh vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 24 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139264166/
